ghi_chu: C 18/11/2026 — bản tiếng Anh của THẺ gửi Jev (ma trận ô 3: EN / EN+VI). C tự dịch từ the_wf.json 8b34455b + the_dac_thu.json 5914e585 (chữ mình viết). Khoá = mã thẻ.

kpi_hoi_nhanh.covers: Quick answer about sales pay / KPI bonus for the team or one employee in the current period (provisional numbers, checked by code). Use for: how much one employee or the whole team gets, why there is no money yet, how much is missing to reach the next tier, comparing two people, extra bonuses, progress / percent of target reached.
kpi_hoi_nhanh.not_for: An official approved table or an Excel file (=> template 6 / 15); a full per-KPI sheet for one employee (=> one-employee sheet); questions not about pay / bonus.

kpi_bang_excel.ten: Template 6 — Team bonus table with Excel export
kpi_bang_excel.covers: Builds the official team bonus table, waits for the manager's approval, then exports an Excel file. Use when the official team table or an Excel file to send is needed.
kpi_bang_excel.not_for: A quick single number; only wanting to SEE numbers / totals without an official table or file (=> KPI quick answer); wanting a quick look now AND the official table (=> template 15).

kpi_xem_nhanh_chinh_thuc.ten: Template 15 — Quick view plus approved official table
kpi_xem_nhanh_chinh_thuc.covers: One run: the upper branch returns provisional numbers immediately, the lower branch builds the official table for approval and then exports Excel. Use when the user wants a quick team total AND the approved official table.
kpi_xem_nhanh_chinh_thuc.not_for: A quick single number; only viewing, no official table or file yet (=> KPI quick answer); only the official table + Excel with no preview (=> template 6).

kpi_ban_tin.covers: A monitoring bulletin for managers: team total + who has most / least, who is close to the next tier, what in the data needs attention — three questions in one run. Use when a manager wants the overall picture at the start / end of a period.
kpi_ban_tin.not_for: A question about one specific employee.

kpi_phieu_nhan_vien.ten: Template 13 — One-employee sheet with 8 KPIs and extra bonuses
kpi_phieu_nhan_vien.covers: Full sheet for ONE employee: money per KPI with reasons, extra bonuses, total. Use when a full explanation for one employee is needed (sales pay slip).
kpi_phieu_nhan_vien.not_for: A quick single number for one employee (=> KPI quick answer); questions about the whole team.

hoi_du_lieu_thu.covers: Natural-language questions over SAMPLE DATA (not bonus figures): the assistant writes an SQL query and returns a table. Use for raw sales / order figures in the sample data.

tai_lieu_rag.covers: Answers from documents uploaded to the organisation's document store (PDF / Word), with file name and page. Use for questions about the content of a document, policy or report that was uploaded.
